name: xtape
description: An ESP32-S3 devkit with a microSD card in it joins your Wi-Fi and serves the card's music over HTTP:

scripts.font:jura: npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/Jura-VariableFont_wght.ttf --size 36 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range '0x20-0x7F,0xA0-0xFF,0x2010-0x2015,0x2018-0x201D,0x2026' --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name jura_36 --output components/app/screen_display/font_jura_36.c
scripts.font:jura28: npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/Jura-VariableFont_wght.ttf --size 28 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range '0x20-0x7F,0xA0-0xFF,0x2010-0x2015,0x2018-0x201D,0x2026' --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name jura_28 --output components/app/screen_display/font_jura_28.c
scripts.font:jura20: npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/Jura-VariableFont_wght.ttf --size 20 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range '0x20-0x7F,0xA0-0xFF,0x2010-0x2015,0x2018-0x201D,0x2026' --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name jura_20 --output components/app/screen_display/font_jura_20.c
scripts.font:xtape: npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/xtape.ttf --size 24 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range 0xF000-0xF013 --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name xtape_24 --output components/app/screen_display/font_xtape_24.c && npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/xtape.ttf --size 36 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range 0xF000-0xF017 --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name xtape_36 --output components/app/screen_display/font_xtape_36.c && npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/xtape.ttf --size 314 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range 0xF00F --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name xtape_logo_128 --output components/app/screen_display/font_xtape_logo_128.c && npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/xtape.ttf --size 125 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range 0xF019 --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name xtape_sd_128 --output components/app/screen_display/font_xtape_sd_128.c
